intent: Record as reviewed further rules the batch Context enforces and tests.
observable_outcome: get-context batch lists the rules as reviewed, each proven by its test.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A trial counts as passed only when its outcome is met; a partially met trial is judged but not passed.
Only judged trials enter a pass rate; running, pending, awaiting-answer and not-evaluated trials count in neither its numerator nor its denominator.
pass@k is true once any trial passes, false only when all k are judged and none passed, and unknown otherwise.
A batch report asked for under another Skill of the same Workspace answers not found.
A batch report carries the skill-withheld arm and the skill effect only when the batch was created withholding the skill.
A paired difference gets a confidence interval only from two or more pairs; one pair gives the difference alone.
A paired test case counts as better only when its rate is strictly higher, worse when strictly lower, and tied when equal.
A trial whose run failed reads as running while its judging is under way, rather than as not evaluated.
A pass rate carries a 95 percent Wilson score interval, and none when nothing is judged.
A test case is marked prompt-varied only when its trials started from more than one distinct prompt.
A simulated answer refused because the conversation has no further round closes the trial instead of failing the batch.
